items.name: Execution/LockedPasteTests.swift:110 stopsALargeCopyAtOnce... (T-97d6fd58, gated)
items.reason: Slow because: 150 MB file written to the host disk, an APFS image mounted, up to three timed attempts with a 0.5 ms polling thread
items.covered: Cheaper way: The stop-part-way behavior is also asserted on a mock by `Execution/PartialFileTests.swift:89`; for the real disk, one attempt with a smaller file if the copy stays slow enough to stop

items.name: Native/NativeCopyTests.swift:209 failsWithENOSPC... (T-26424164, gated)
items.reason: Slow because: 80 MB source plus `fillDisk` writing about 256 MB into the image (1 MB files, then 64 KB)
items.covered: Cheaper way: The disk is full before the copy, so the source can be 1 to 2 MB; use a 32 MB image kind for fill tests (the original used 20 MB; `tools/fixtures/disk-images.sh` makes 256 MB)

items.name: Native/NativeCopyTests.swift:173 stopsPartWay... (T-19343d44, gated)
items.reason: Slow because: 150 MB file and an image
items.covered: Cheaper way: Needs a copy slow enough to stop: no safe shrink known

items.name: Execution/PasteThroughputTests.swift:21 and Copy/CopyThroughputTests.swift:15 (gated, no id)
items.reason: Slow because: each writes a 150 MB file and times several copies against a bare copyfile on an image
items.covered: Cheaper way: Both measure the same 5 % bound at two layers; share one file and one mount in one test

items.name: Native/NativeCopyTests.swift:232 failsWithTheWritesErrno...ResourceFork (T-0c2e0a1d, not gated)
items.reason: Slow because: APFS image, `fillDisk` to full (about 256 MB), then a fork larger than the free space

items.name: Native/NativeCopyTests.swift:259 ...SmallResourceFork (T-1c84056e, not gated)

items.name: Execution/LargeTreeExecutionTests.swift:135 analyzesAndCopiesEveryItem (T-aa0802fe)
items.reason: Slow because: 150,000 mock items analyzed, resolved and pasted
items.covered: Cheaper way: The review half repeats `Analysis/LargeTreeAnalysisTests.swift:91`; build the 150,000-item tree once and reuse it (the 125,000 bound belongs to the original's JavaScript argument limit)

items.name: Analysis/LargeTreeAnalysisTests.swift:91 reviewsAFolderOfMoreThan125000Items... (no id)
items.reason: Slow because: the same 150,000-item tree, with a wait of up to 120 s

items.name: FolderSize/FolderSizeJobsTests.swift:568 keepsUpWithAWalk... (T-2cdd29eb)
items.reason: Slow because: 200,000 sizes in 20 takes, bound of 6 s; the neighbors `:293` (110,000), `:263` (30,000 plus 3,000 changes) and `FolderSize/FolderSizeCacheTests.swift:122` (400,000 stores, bound 5 s) do the same kind of loop
items.covered: Cheaper way: Only `:293` needs more than 100,000 (the old limit); the three others test complexity and can use a fifth of the size with a proportional bound

items.name: Watch/FolderWatchStreamTests.swift (7 tests, fixed sleeps)
items.reason: Slow because: 300 ms start wait in six tests, then negative waits of 1,200, 800 and 800 ms, with real FSEvents; about 5 s of fixed sleeping together
items.covered: Cheaper way: FSEvents latency is 0.05 s (`FSEventsFolderWatcher.latencySeconds`); the negative waits can be about 250 ms, and `:111` and `:139` can share one folder

items.name: Disk images (42 tests, 47 mounts, 6 mounts gated)
items.reason: Every test clones a 256 MB image, attaches, detaches, and waits on a lock that allows one volume of a kind at a time, so the 26 APFS mounts of OP (20 of them not gated) run one after another. 15 of them need only a second device number and could use NativePaste.asOnAnotherDisk(source) (already used in Execution/CopyPasteExecutionRealFSTests.swift:64, Execution/RuntimeSafetyTests.swift:31 and four more places): Execution/LockedPasteTests.swift:40, :63, :87; Replace/LockedReplaceTests.swift:89, :115; Execution/UndoRecordingTests.swift:368, :387, :407, :433; Replace/UndoReplaceTests.swift:168, :1

items.name: FAT and exFAT run twice (5 tests)
items.reason: Native/NativeRenameTests.swift:62, :135, Execution/CopyPasteVolumesTests.swift:169, :183, Replace/WriteServiceReplaceTests.swift:265 use arguments: [.fat32, .exfat], so each mounts two images; one kind per test would save 5 mounts, or both kinds could share one mount per suite.

items.name: Fill-disk tests (4):
items.reason: NativeCopyTests.swift:209, :232, :259 and Execution/CopyPasteVolumesTests.swift:141 (T-0e57438e, gated, 8 MB source plus fillDisk). One 32 MB image kind for all four.

items.name: Real-folder size
items.reason: Listing/NativeFileSystemTests.swift:55 readsAFolderTooBigForOneBuffer creates 6,000 files so the listing overruns its 256 KB bulk buffer; a smaller buffer passed in by the test would need far fewer. FolderSize/NativeFolderSizeTests.swift:230 walks /usr/share and :238 walks /System/Volumes (real system trees; no smaller parent contains a firmlink).

items.name: Real fd on /
items.reason: Search/FdSearchProcessTests.swift:175 and :188 search the whole disk for a name that never matches and poll ps until fd shows (up to 5 s) and ends (up to 2 s). A large folder such as /usr would keep fd alive long enough.
